data.summary: Experiment E090 compared hand-driven vs automated classification of embedded/microcontroller fault code topics using the view_count rubric. 100% agreement across all 30 topics (7 need, 3 served, 4 unserved-open-like, 23 not-a-need). Need fraction 23.3%, served 10.0%, unserved-open-like 13.3%, VC positive 100%. Gates: G1 fail (need 15/30 required, have 7/30), G3 pass (upper CI < 60%), G4 pass (100% VC positive >= 95%). No candidate produced; experiment validates classification framework robustness. Per D083: next action is fresh observation in new domain.
